text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Angolan government said it woudl relaunch its industrial sector in 1997 after two decades of civil war.
- The Romanian Ambassador to Angola Alexandru Bogoroditsa said the main cause of difficulties in Angola's peace progress was distrust between government and former rebel UNITA movement.
- The Angolan government is preparing to rebuild basic infrastructures in the northern oil-rich town of Soyo.
